BTS Group Concludes Investor Relations Academy 2026 - Cohort 2, Reinforcing Its Commitment to Developing a New Generation of Capital Market Talent

Back 17 August 2026

17th August 2026 – BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited (BTS Group) held the closing ceremony of the Investor Relations (IR) Academy 2026 - Cohort 2. Mr. Daniel Ross, Chief Investment Officer and Head of IR and Sustainability Development, represented the Company in presenting certificates to all nine programme participants. The ceremony was attended by executives from across the Group, including Mr. Sumit Srisantithum, Chief Operating Officer of Bangkok Mass Transit System Public Company Limited, and Ms. Soraya Satiangoset, Acting Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer of Rabbit Holdings Public Company Limited.

The IR Academy 2026 - Cohort 2 is a two-month programme designed to develop the capabilities of aspiring IR professionals. Participants gained both theoretical knowledge and hands-on experience through practical training with BTS Group’s professional IR team, study visits to various companies within the BTS Group, and learning sessions with guest speakers and senior executives from the financial and capital market sectors, as well as experienced IR professionals. The programme also featured practical workshops on financial data analysis and investor meeting simulations. Through this comprehensive learning experience, participants developed practical and in-depth skills essential to a career in IR.

Mr. Kavin Kanjanapas, Director and Chief Executive Officer of BTS Group, said, “In a rapidly changing business environment, driving organisational growth requires quality people. The IR Academy serves as a testament to BTS Group’s commitment to developing the potential of the next generation of talent, not only to prepare them for the future of the organisation, but also to help build a strong foundation for Thailand’s capital market. We have always believed that ‘people’ are the most valuable asset in driving sustainable business growth.”

As the next step, BTS Group will assess and select participants who meet the final criteria for potential employment in IR positions or other suitable roles. The programme also aligns with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal (UN SDG) 4: Quality Education, reflecting BTS Group’s commitment to integrating business success with creating positive value for society.
